links.prior: docs/reports/2026-10-29-degree-three-module-rss/ (retrospective, unfrozen; container run OOM-killed at 13.52 GB anon by a 13.36 GiB memcg)
links.note: Frozen before any data of this rerun. Replaces the 2026-10-29 retrospective record's role for the claims below; that record stays as it is.

question: On a GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner, what is the full peak anonymous memory of elaborating CryptoResearch.Semaev.BooleanParityDegreeThreeRankCertificate at the current pins, does LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1 lower it beyond the A/A spread, and how much margin does the runner leave?

claims.text: The peak RssAnon of the lean process elaborating the module with default threads on the hosted runner, measured by 0.5 s sampling, in two A/A runs.
LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1 lowers that peak by more than max(A/A spread, 256 MiB).
claims.if_supported: LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1 is a memory mitigation on this runner, by the measured amount only
claims.if_not_supported: thread count does not move the peak beyond noise; it is not a fix

claims.text: Runner margin = MemTotal + SwapTotal - max default peak; under 1 GiB counts as fragile.

hypotheses.statement: The module's peak anonymous memory is above 13.5 GB and close to the hosted runner's ~16 GB.
hypotheses.mechanism: maxHeartbeats 0 and kernel reduction of a large finite rank certificate keep a growing heap in one elaboration task.

predictions.minimum_effect: above 13,500,000 kB in both default arms

data_seen.measured: 13.52 GB anon at the container OOM kill, LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1, older pins

predictions.minimum_effect: threads1 within max(A/A, 256 MiB) of default-a

data_seen.measured: 8 OS threads and one growing heap under LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1

arms.description: lake env lean on the module, default Lean threads, first in order
same command with LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1, second in order
repeat of default-a, third in order: the A/A noise floor

positive.not_applicable_reason: the sampler is checked on every arm: a run with no lean process observed (peak 0) is invalid in the frozen analysis; and the 2026-10-29 container run is an independent positive observation (13.52 GB, kernel OOM record)

negative.not_applicable_reason: no null population; a deterministic elaboration of one module

factors.name: module_source
factors.how: committed file; recorded per run in host.json

factors.name: toolchain
factors.value: formal/lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json at the PR head (Lean v4.35.0, Mathlib cfc55fc5 at writing)

factors.name: dependencies
factors.value: BooleanParitySemanticRankCertificate and its closure built before the arms

factors.name: host
factors.how: one runner for all three arms; MemTotal, SwapTotal, nproc, cgroup memory.max, image recorded in host.json

factors.name: page_cache_and_order
factors.how: fixed order default-a, threads1, default-b; default-b repeats default-a after the others, so order effects show in C-aa

comparisons.threshold: peak_lean_rss_anon_kb reported as measured; P1 holds if both > 13,500,000 kB

randomization.arm_order_reason: memory peak of a deterministic elaboration has no warm-up cost to balance; the A/A arm runs last so any order effect shows in C-aa

seed_derivation.note: Lean elaboration is deterministic; there is no seed

blinding.how: not masked: the frozen script computes every verdict mechanically

power.note: no significance test; C2 compares against the A/A spread with a 256 MiB floor, fixed here before data

preflight_runtime.measured_on: hosted job logs 2026-10-28: module 579-671 s; workspace setup ~10 min

primary.name: peak anonymous RSS of lean
primary.definition: max over 0.5 s samples of /proc/<lean>/status RssAnon
primary.resolution: 1 kB at 0.5 s sampling (a spike shorter than 0.5 s can be missed)

stopping_rules.rule: one job: three arms in fixed order, then stop
a job that dies before the first arm starts (checkout, install, cache, dependency build, runner loss) is re-run once; a job that reaches an arm is never re-run for its result

invalidation_rules: an arm with exit != 0, a watchdog kill, or no lean process observed is invalid; its peak is a lower bound only
a change to the module, the pins or the analysis script after freeze voids the run

decision_rule.text: C1: report both default peaks (valid arms only). C2 supported if default-a minus threads1 exceeds max(|default-a - default-b|, 256 MiB), all three arms valid; else within_control_distribution; invalid_measurement if any arm is invalid. C3: margin = MemTotal + SwapTotal - max default peak, fragile below 1 GiB.
decision_rule.threshold: C2: difference > max(A/A spread, 262144 kB); C3: margin < 1048576 kB is fragile
decision_rule.interval: A/A spread as the noise floor

inadmissible: changing the arms, order, thresholds or analysis after seeing data
re-running a job that reached an arm to get a different number
reading a hosted-runner peak as the container's, or the reverse
reading wall time as a performance claim
